papers.title_en: Distillation for Efficient Multitask Manipulation Policies via Conditional Flow Matching
papers.authors: Shreya Deshmukh, Imen Mahdi, Nick Heppert, Abhinav Valada
papers.evidence: 条件流匹配用于生成式策略学习
papers.tldr: 生成式策略在机器人操作中表现突出，但条件流匹配（CFM）多聚焦单任务，独立训练多任务模型计算代价高。直接将多任务演示拼接训练又需更大模型容量，或导致性能下降。本文提出将单任务CFM专家的速度场蒸馏到共享多任务策略，并与原CFM目标联合优化。在RLBench上，该方法在固定模型尺寸下优于朴素多任务训练，同时避免为每个任务单独训练模型。
papers.abstract_en: Advances in generative modeling have recently been extensively employed in robotics for policy learning. In particular, Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) trained with expert demonstrations has been shown to outperform existing methods on robot manipulation benchmarks. While prior work has mainly focused on single-task settings, we study the problem from a multi-task perspective, as training independent models for each task is computationally expensive. Multi-Task policy learning comes with its own set of challenges, as naively training on a concatenated dataset of demonstrations would either require increased model capacity to accommodate the added complexity or result in drops in performance. We propose to distill knowledge from single-task CFM experts into a shared multi-task policy by transferring their learned velocity fields. We combine this distillation signal with the original CFM objective to retain fidelity to the demonstrations. Experiments on RLBench show that our approach improves multi-task policy performance over naive training while maintaining a fixed model size.

papers.title_en: ReaFlow-TTS: Realization-Conditioned Flow Matching for High-Quality and Controllable Speech Synthesis
papers.authors: Junyi Zhao, Yihao Qin, Changsheng Ma
papers.evidence: 用于语音合成生成建模的流匹配
papers.tldr: 流匹配 TTS 中，同一生成条件下不同语音实现会产生不同目标速度，而以平方误差训练的确定性速度场只预测条件均值，抹平了实现相关变化，也缺乏可解释的属性操控接口。ReaFlow-TTS 引入话语级随机实现隐变量，在整条生成轨迹上条件化速度预测，并将 VAD 语义施加到实现空间。实验显示其合成质量优于匹配的全掩码基线，隐变量在不同初始噪声下可复现地影响音高、能量与时序，主观评测支持分级 VAD 操控且自然度仅小幅下降。该工作把实现条件建模为可复用、可解释的控制变量，为高质量可控 TTS 提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: In flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS), different speech realizations can induce different target velocities under the same generation conditions. A deterministic velocity field trained with squared error predicts their conditional mean, thereby marginalizing realization-dependent variation. Meanwhile, modeling such variation does not inherently provide a semantically interpretable interface for attribute manipulation. We propose ReaFlow-TTS, a realization-conditioned flow-matching framework that introduces an utterance-level stochastic realization latent and uses it to condition velocity prediction throughout the generation trajectory. We further impose valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) semantics on the realization space, enabling direct and graded attribute manipulation without target speech at inference. Experiments demonstrate improved synthesis quality over a matched full-mask baseline and reproducible latent-induced pitch, energy, and timing tendencies across initial-noise samples, providing behavioral evidence that the latent is used as a reusable realization condition. Subjective evaluation further demonstrates graded VAD manipulation across generation contexts with only modest changes in naturalness.

papers.title_en: Faster Visuomotor Policy Learning on Action Manifolds via Riemannian MeanFlow
papers.authors: S. Talha Bukhari, Austin Garrett, Yi Wei, Ruiqi Ni, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 动作流形上的扩散与流匹配策略
papers.tldr: 视觉运动策略常依赖扩散模型与流匹配，虽能建模多模态动作分布，却需多步数值积分，导致动作生成慢、控制频率受限；同时机器人动作序列通常位于光滑可微流形上，策略须尊重其内在几何。本文提出黎曼平均流策略 RMFP，在机器人动作流形上学习条件流映射，并以黎曼条件流匹配为数据锚，配合流映射一致性目标约束有限时间传输。该目标训练稳定，仅需一次网络函数评估即可在流形上生成动作序列。在球形 LASA、Push-T、Robomimic 的 Tool Hang/Transport、Franka Kitchen 及真实机器人操作任务中，RMFP 以更低采样成本取得与先前工作相当的性能，并验证真实场景下快速动作生成能力。
papers.abstract_en: Visuomotor policies learn a direct map from raw sensory observations to robot action sequences. Policies based on Diffusion and Flow Matching capture the multimodal distribution over action sequences in an end-to-end manner. This expressivity comes at the cost of multi-step numerical integration of the learned vector field for action generation, which can be expensive and time-consuming, impeding fast control rates required in robotics applications. Furthermore, robot action sequences are usually defined on a smooth, differentiable manifold, requiring that the learned policy respects the intrinsic geometry of the robot's action space. Here, we present Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), which learns the conditioned flow map of the probability path on the robot action manifold. Our formulation employs a flow map consistency objective grounded in the data by a Riemannian Conditional Flow Matching anchor. The flow map consistency condition is stable to train and constrains the learned model to finite-time transport, which yields on-manifold action sequence generation with as few as one network function evaluation. We present results on the spherical LASA and Push-T benchmarks, on the Tool Hang and Transport tasks of the Robomimic suite, and on the Franka Kitchen task with manifold-constrained action generation, and demonstrate that RMFP attains performance competitive with prior work at a lower sampling cost. We also employ RMFP on a real-world robotic manipulation task to demonstrate fast action generation under imperfect sensor measurements in the physical world.
